title: How to share a Post to WhatsApp

runs: A protected Post cannot be shared.
If you’re signed into WhatsApp on your device, your >x< app will close, and WhatsApp will open.
The Post you want to share becomes a screenshot to share through WhatsApp.
You can share the Post with a single person or a group in a message. From there, they can tap the URL of the Post screenshot to go to >x< and join the conversation.
